name: echo
description: Echo: A privacy-focused communication platform with real-time chat, voice, and community features.

scripts.dev: bun server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n backend,web,bot,activities -c auto "bun run --filter backend dev" "bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && bun run --filter web dev" "bun server/ops/scripts/dev-discord-bot.mjs" "bun run --filter activities dev"
scripts.dev:core: bun server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n backend,web -c auto "bun run --filter backend dev" "bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && bun run --filter web dev"
scripts.dev:core:low-mem: bun server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -n backend,web -c auto "bun run --filter backend dev" "bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && bun run --filter web dev:low-mem"
scripts.dev:lan: bun run lan:sync && bun server/ops/scripts/compose.mjs up -d --force-recreate livekit coturn && bun run dev
scripts.prod: bun run preverify:prod && bun run build && bun run prod:serve
scripts.prod:serve: cross-env ECHO_FREE_PORTS=3000,4173,3005 bun server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -c auto -n backend,web,bot "cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run start" "bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter web preview" "bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs 127.0.0.1 4173 && bun server/ops/scripts/prod-discord-bot.mjs"
scripts.prod:smoke: cross-env ECHO_FREE_PORTS=3000,4173,3005 bun server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -c auto -n backend,web,bot "cross-env NODE_ENV=production ECHO_REQUIRE_REDIS_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_REQUIRE_METRICS_SCRAPE_TOKEN_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_REQUIRE_MEDIA_URL_HARDENING_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_REQUIRE_GUEST_BINDING_SECRET_IN_PRODUCTION=false ECHO_ALLOW_EMBEDDED_VIDEO_HLS=true bun run start" "bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run --filter web preview" "bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs 127.0.0.1 4173 && bun server/ops/scripts/prod-discord-bot.mjs"
scripts.build:workspaces: bun server/ops/scripts/copy-twemoji.mjs && bun server/ops/scripts/build-emoji-secondary-aliases.mjs && bun server/ops/scripts/build-emoji-search-index.mjs && bun run --filter web build && bun run --filter marketing build && bun run --filter backend build && bun run --filter bot build && bun run --filter activities build && bun run --filter media build
scripts.test:ci: bun run format:check && bun run test:ci:guards && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 bun run --filter web build && bun run --filter backend build && bun run --filter web test:coverage -- --reporter=dot && bun run test:ci:backend && bun run --filter activities test
scripts.ci:precheck: bun run test:ci && bun run --filter web lint && bun run --filter web lint:theme && bun run --filter web lint:style && bun run --filter backend lint && bun run --filter web i18n:check
scripts.test:ci:guards: bun server/ops/scripts/check-oss-artifacts.mjs && bun server/ops/scripts/check-github-remote-policy.mjs && bun run version:test && bun server/ops/scripts/check-god-file-ratchet.mjs && bun run apple:maintainability && bun server/ops/scripts/check-new-code-charter.mjs && bun run check:echo-channels && bun run check:echo-snowflake && bun run check:echo-single-reality && bun run check:echo-rbac && bun run check:channel-message-writes && bun server/ops/scripts/check-echo-no-sql-in-routes.mjs && bun run check:sql-schema-columns && bun run check:voice-activity && bun run placement:check && bun run check:feature-boundaries && bun run check:dep-audit && bun run docs:links:check && bun run modularity:report
scripts.test:ci:backend: bun run --filter backend test:storage-mode && bun run --filter backend test:video-hls-worker-config && bun run --filter media test:video-hls-notify && bun run --filter backend test:production-config-gates && bun run --filter backend test:linkUnfurlStubs && bun run --filter backend test:gifProviders && bun run --filter backend test:linkUnfurlExtract && bun run --filter backend test:shipping-security && bun run --filter backend test:security && bun run --filter backend test:echo:contract && bun run --filter media test && bun run check:echo-channels && bun run check:echo-snowflake && bun run check:echo-single-reality && bun run check:echo-rbac && bun run check:channel-message-writes && bun server/ops/scripts/check-echo-no-sql-in-routes.mjs && bun run check:sql-schema-columns && bun test server/backend/src/tests/paper/paperCollabState.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/paper/paperAttribution.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/platform/socketOpEnvelope.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/servers/echo.serverMemberIdsCache.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/members/echoEventUserCache.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/unfurl/unfurlCache.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/channels/echo.channelMetaCache.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/permissions/echo.permissionAggregateParity.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/servers/echo.serverAggregateCache.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/platform/keyedCoalescer.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/auth/idTokens.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/platform/gcraRateLimiter.test.ts && bun test server/backend/src/tests/platform/messageRateLimiter.test.ts
scripts.test:ci:backend:integration: cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo USE_MOCK_DB=false bun run --filter backend test:echo:pipeline && cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo NATS_URL=nats://127.0.0.1:4222 USE_MOCK_DB=false bun run --filter backend test:echo:multinode && cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo USE_MOCK_DB=false bun run --filter backend test:echo:uploads && cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=postgres DATABASE_URL=postgresql://echo:echo_dev@127.0.0.1:5432/echo USE_MOCK_DB=false bun run --filter backend test:echo:rbac
scripts.verify:ship:integration: bun run test:ci && bun run test:ci:backend:integration
scripts.ship:verify: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build && bun server/ops/scripts/ship-verify-smoke.mjs
scripts.redeploy:pm2: bun run build && bun run publish:web-active && pm2 restart echo-backend echo-video-hls-worker echo-web echo-marketing
scripts.dev:e2e: bun server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -k -n backend,web -c auto "cross-env ECHO_BACKEND_STORAGE=memory DATABASE_URL= NODE_ENV=development USE_MOCK_DB=true ECHO_GUEST_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=1 bun run --filter backend dev:e2e" "cross-env VITE_ECHO_GUEST_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=1 bun server/ops/scripts/wait-for-port.mjs && bun run --filter web dev:e2e"
scripts.test:e2e: bun server/ops/scripts/kill-dev-ports.mjs && concurrently -k -s command-cypress -n stack,cypress -c auto "bun run dev:e2e" "wait-on -t 120000 http://localhost:8080 && bun run --filter web cy:run"
